DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Hello, I am a NPC."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I am talking to you right now."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Thank god you're here! I sent a letter to my boss earlier, but I need to get it back before he sees it..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "He lives at the red cliff house. Do you think he's read it yet?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "One of my employees wrote this? I can't believe it... this... is..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Can you take this note back to him? He works in the main square."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I'm getting... promoted?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Wow, who would have known that acting on my lowest instincts would help me advance in the corporate world."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Hey there! Can you please take this postcard to my wife? She sells flowers in the main square."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I'd give it to her myself but I... uh... have a bad knee at the moment..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Oh, a postcard from my husband!"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "He's on an overseas business trip at the moment, visiting all kinds of exotic places!"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Look, between you and me, I know he's living in a cave in the forest... I hope his midlife crisis passes soon..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Would you mind bringing him these clean clothes? Don't say they're from me. Just tell him he won a prize."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Wow, another prize?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Just in time, too. I'm down to my last pair of underwear."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Hey, can you help me with something? We're short on staff lately and, well, some of our mail went to the wrong address by mistake..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Go find Doctor Frieb and see if he's received any packages lately. He lives at the base of the mountain temple."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "They probably mixed me up with Doctor Frebi at Capital Corp..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I... uh... ordered the wrong thing anyway... Tell her I don't need it anymore..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Oh hey, you work for the delivery company? I've been meaning to talk to you guys..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Do you know why I received 63 packets of instant noodles? Was that meant to go to the grocery store or something?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "You don't know anything about that? Oh well. Thanks for the package."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Excuse me, could you please take this offering up to the mountain temple for me?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I have trouble making it up the slope by myself these days."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Oh, pastries and sake?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "My favourite."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Check this out! I was diving for oysters earlier and found these old lock boxes buried in the sand."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "One of them had a letter inside. It's a bit wet, but I can make out the name Dave at the top."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Pretty crazy huh? I know a guy called Dave. Do you think it could be the same one?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "He's probably down at smelly falls, if you want to take it to him."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "A letter for me? From under the sea? The one who wrote it... is me!"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Let's see what I wrote to myself all those years ago..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Dear Future Dave..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Keep practicing every day..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Get plenty of sunshine..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Take care of your hair. Let it grow wild and free. Your hair is your soul and the most defining feature of your personality."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Looks like I slept in... I better start today's deliveries."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I've got five on the list. Hopefully they're easy to find."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Alright, I better get going."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Sorry, I'm on my lunch break."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Senior associate executive chief vice director..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "It has a nice ring to it, don't you think?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Have you seen my daughter? I thought she'd be home by now..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Maybe I should just call in sick..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Tulips can take a while to bloom."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I think I hear my dad calling..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Have you heard of a thing called three.js?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Well... I suppose most people don't know about 3D experiences."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "They're an art form that combines creativity and technology."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "It's like painting, but with code!"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Shipments in... shipments out..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "The new guy is late again."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "We'll need to build here... here... and also here..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I think I've seen you somewhere before..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Let's see... First I'll need to calculate the radius of the bike tire..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Come on... open up..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Do you hear that sound? Silence..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "I mean, there's the wind chimes too, but it's mostly silence..."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Thank you for delivering my offering."

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Have you heard this one before?"

DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.label: DIALOGUE_SENTENCE
DIALOGUE_SENTENCE.text: "Capital Corp."
